$comment: Sigil's qwentts.cpp server packs for Qwen3-TTS (tts_helpers::qwen, owned by P6-E): sigil-tts-server.exe, built by scripts/runtime-packs/qwentts/build.ps1 from the pinned upstream (scripts/runtime-packs/qwentts/UPSTREAM.json: qwentts.cpp 6fae929 and its ggml fork 40e16e4, MIT) plus server/sigil-tts-server.cpp (API key, loopback-only bind, extracted voice latents, /sigil/info). ggml is linked statically; nothing but the GPU driver (vulkan-1.dll, nvcuda.dll) and, for cuda13, cuBLAS from runtime/nvidia-cuda13 (put on the helper's PATH) is loaded beside it.

Run as the process_host helper tts-qwen3 (127.0.0.1, random port and key, kill-on-close Job Object). Vulkan is the default GPU pack (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel); CUDA 13 is preferred on NVIDIA Turing or newer when installed; the CPU pack is for PCs without a usable GPU (slower than real time on most processors).

Asset hosting is local only: the packs stay 'unpublished' and unpinned (install them by Import in Models & Runtimes or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS; the zips are found by file name). The vulkan variant needs the Vulkan SDK on the build PC. Pin size and sha256 from the build's .zip.sha256 when publishing.
Upgrade: bump UPSTREAM.json (commit, archives, shim_revision, catalog_version), then every id's version and zip name here together, and re-run the build's -SelfTest.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS server (Vulkan)
entries.description: Runs Qwen3-TTS voices on the graphics card through Vulkan: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel. Started by Sigil as a helper process that only listens on this PC.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS server (CUDA 13)
entries.description: Runs Qwen3-TTS voices on NVIDIA graphics cards through CUDA 13. Needs driver R580 or newer and a Turing (GTX 16 / RTX 20) or newer GPU; installs the NVIDIA GPU runtime with it.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS server (processor)
entries.description: Runs Qwen3-TTS voices on the processor, for PCs without a suitable graphics card. Slower than real time on most processors: Kokoro is the better voice there.
